title: Personal Hardship Assistance, NSW East Coast Severe Weather – Terms and Conditions
summary: This document outlines the terms and conditions for the East Coast Severe Weather Personal Hardship Assistance grant payment.
who_can_apply: The grant is related to the East Coast Severe Weather Personal Hardship Assistance – May 2025 Program.
The terms and conditions apply to applicants for the grant payment.

The Crown may refuse a grant if the application was not approved, if the applicant already received a grant, if the application is suspected or deemed fraudulent, or if the applicant has not repaid a previous payment sought as a debt.

faqs.q: Who does 'we' refer to in these terms and conditions?
faqs.a: References to 'we', 'our' or 'us' refer to the Crown in right of the State of New South Wales acting through Service NSW or through another administrative unit or authority of the Crown in right of the State of New South Wales.

faqs.q: What is the 'Program' referred to in these terms?
faqs.a: The 'Program' means the East Coast Severe Weather Personal Hardship Assistance – May 2025.

faqs.q: How can I apply for the grant?
faqs.a: You can apply in person at a Service NSW Centre, Mobile Service Centre, or any other authorized centre (like a Recovery Assistance Point); via your MyServiceNSW Account on the Service NSW website or mobile application; or as otherwise notified by Service NSW on the Service NSW website.
